## Summary

What does this change do, and why? Link the related issue.

## How I checked it

- [ ] `pnpm format:check`, `pnpm lint`, and `pnpm build` pass
- [ ] `cargo fmt --all --check` and `cargo clippy --workspace --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings` pass (for Rust changes)
- [ ] I tried the change in the packaged application (`pnpm package`)

Describe the manual checks: what you did, what you expected, and what
happened, including error cases and both the light and dark themes for
interface changes.

For a change to a language file only, you can skip the commands above; say
where in the application you checked the text, if you did.

## Interface text

If you added or changed interface text, list the message ids in `en.json`.
Translations into the other languages are not needed. Translation-only
changes can leave this empty.

## Screenshots or video

For interface changes, add before and after screenshots. For motion or
animation changes, add a short video.
